_about: The founder's cards on the About page. Every card is in Scott's own voice and only Scott approves one. status: approved (shown on the public site), draft (shown only in the local preview, marked Draft), hold (waits for the thing named in 'waits_for'), retired (kept here, never shown). kind: always (in every rotation), now (shown only inside its windows, for a season, a release or a campaign), evergreen (takes turns: two at a time, changing every two weeks). The plan is in 06_market/00_imprint/market_founder_cards.md.

cards.ties_to: The mission statement; campaign c01, post 10
cards.heading: Building One Good Book at a Time
cards.text: I started Quiet Grid Press because I wanted puzzle books that treat the reader well: honest difficulty, generous layouts, and nothing rushed. Bible Verse Sudoku is the first book in a series of seven King James Version collections, and the start of a catalog I am building one title at a time, around calm recreation, careful craftsmanship, and lasting value.

cards.ties_to: The Thanksgiving posts of campaigns c01 and c02
cards.heading: With Thanks
cards.text: Thank you for making room for a puzzle book from a small press. I am grateful for every reader who picks up a pencil and spends a quiet hour with one of our books.

cards.ties_to: Campaign c01, post 09 (thoughtful gifts); blog c02_03 (a quiet gift)
cards.heading: A Quiet Gift
cards.text: A puzzle book is a quiet gift. It asks for nothing but a pencil and a few unhurried minutes. I hope ours feels made with care when it is opened.

cards.waits_for: The new USA250 Sudoku live on Amazon; then Scott gives the dates for its window
cards.heading: 250 Puzzles for the 250th
cards.text: USA250 Sudoku is 250 puzzles in ten chapters, made for America's 250th year.

cards.heading: When a Book Says Easy
cards.text: A difficulty label is a promise. When one of our books says Easy, every puzzle in it can be finished with plain logic and no guessing, and each one is checked before the book is printed.

cards.ties_to: Campaign c01, post 04; blog c01_01 (why every puzzle has one solution)
cards.heading: The Quiet Part of the Work
cards.text: Every puzzle is checked to have exactly one solution before it goes into a book. Nobody sees that work. You feel it when a puzzle simply makes sense.

cards.ties_to: Campaign c01, post 05 (one puzzle to a page)
cards.heading: Room to Think
cards.text: I give each puzzle a page of its own. A clear grid and open space are a way of respecting the person holding the pencil.

cards.ties_to: Campaign c02; blog c02_01 (seven books, one series)
cards.heading: A Verse with Every Puzzle
cards.text: Bible Verse Sudoku grew into seven collections from the King James Version. In each one, every puzzle is paired with a verse, printed exactly, with its chapter and verse.

cards.ties_to: Campaign c01, post 12 (what the name means)
cards.heading: What the Name Means
cards.text: The name says what I am after. Quiet: calm and uncluttered. Grid: logic you can finish. Press: the same care in every book.

cards.ties_to: The thank-you page of Bible Verse Sudoku (Scott's own approved words)
cards.heading: One Careful Move at a Time
cards.text: A Sudoku grid starts with some numbers, and the rest is revealed one careful move at a time. Some spots pop up quickly, while others make us pause, look again, and trust that a clear next move is still possible.
